head: 4e0425201cd9c6b33dce0309096367dc0df13f3a
intent: Add optional Bluetooth and USB gamepad input to ZOS TV mode through evdev and wtype, preserve keyboard and CEC behavior, expose non-fatal component health, and package the service for Debian, appliance, and Nix deployments.
appliedFixes: separated transient Wayland preflight health from injection failures so a compositor that becomes ready after service startup can recover
centralized TV shell notice timer ownership so a gamepad transition cannot clear a later playback error
made full-width i32 axis normalization overflow-safe and added an extreme-range regression test
bounded the evdev event queue and added a two-second wtype timeout with child-process cleanup
replaced the synthetic wtype recovery assertion with a real failing-then-succeeding executable test

advisories.summary: CM5 release validation passed with the controller disconnected; a real Xbox Series or Xbox One S controller is still required to exercise pairing, reconnect behavior, evdev mappings, and simultaneous CEC and keyboard input.
Nix is not installed on the local macOS host, so native Linux nix flake check and the NixOS VM test remain authoritative.
